title: Moderate Suction, Easily Clogged Motor Filter
text:
Moderate Suction, Easily Clogged Motor Filter. This budget-priced (about $40 on Amazon) DIRT DEVIL POWER EXPRESS LITE PET 3-IN-1 CORDED STICK VACUUM (SD22020B) has only moderate suction, and doesn't “pick up” well on carpeted floors, even though it has a powered brush.

When I tried it on carpeted stairs, the motor filters became clogged with fine fuzz almost immediately, and the vac began dropping fuzz back on the carpet. (The troubleshooting guide says this will happen if the motor filter is clogged.) The filter is easy to remove and clean (by brushing it off), but it's very small, without much capacity for fine dust or lint.

I can't imagine using this vac for a large carpeted area. My household has no pets, the stairs are vacuumed fairly often, and the vac picked up only a small amount of hair--yet the filter needed cleaning after only a few minutes of operation. The larger dirt cannister is extremely easy to remove and empty, but it collected almost nothing from my carpeted stairs.

I wanted this vac to clean areas that my Roomba 650 cannot reach, and I suppose it will work for that. However, I was disappointed in this model, because Dirt Devil is a brand that I have come to trust. A Dirt Devil detailer, a Dirt Devil hand vac, and a Dirt Devil upright vac have all performed very well for me in the past.

description: The Dirt Devil Power Express Lite Pet is lightweight, easy to store and is perfect for small spaces and pets. This versatile vacuum is everything you need in one compact design. The stick vacuum is equipped with a powered brush roll that works hard on carpet and hard floors. It also easily converts to a hand vacuum for above floor cleaning. Just pop on the Pet Tool to tackle pet hair on upholstery, stairs, pet beds and furniture. The rinsable filter, easy empty dirt cup and compact design make it easy to use, maintain and store.
